    • direction

      public DualSparkline.Builder direction(Sparkline.RenderDirection direction)
      Sets the render direction. In Sparkline.RenderDirection.LEFT_TO_RIGHT (default) the oldest data point appears at the left and the newest at the right. In Sparkline.RenderDirection.RIGHT_TO_LEFT the newest data point appears at the left, matching a right-to-left scrolling display.
      Parameters:
      direction - the render direction
      Returns:
      this builder

    • showYAxis

      public DualSparkline.Builder showYAxis(boolean show)
      Controls whether a Y-axis label column is rendered on the left. Shows the shared maximum at the top and bottom rows and 0 at the centre row. Defaults to false.
      Parameters:
      show - whether to show the y-axis labels
      Returns:
      this builder

    • yAxisFormatter

      public DualSparkline.Builder yAxisFormatter(LongFunction<String> formatter)
      Sets a custom formatter for Y-axis labels. When set, used instead of the default integer format. The function receives the raw data value and should return a short label (up to 4 characters).
      Parameters:
      formatter - function mapping a data value to a label string
      Returns:
      this builder

    • xLabels

      public DualSparkline.Builder xLabels(String... labels)
      Sets the x-axis labels rendered as a single row below the chart body. Labels are distributed evenly across the data range. The last label is right-aligned at its position so it does not overflow the right edge.

      Example: xLabels("-60s", "-45s", "-30s", "-15s", "now")

      Parameters:
      labels - the labels, distributed left-to-right
      Returns:
      this builder

    • styleResolver

      public DualSparkline.Builder styleResolver(StylePropertyResolver resolver)
      Sets the CSS property resolver used to read top-color and bottom-color properties. Programmatic values set via topForeground(Color) and bottomForeground(Color) take precedence over CSS values.
      Parameters:
      resolver - the resolver
      Returns:
      this builder
